# Wiktionary

> A free, collaborative, multilingual dictionary powered by MediaWiki with comprehensive word definitions, etymologies, pronunciations, and linguistic data across hundreds of languages.

Wiktionary is a community-driven project that provides detailed lexicographical information for words across multiple languages. The platform leverages MediaWiki technology and is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License, making it freely accessible and editable by contributors worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Multilingual dictionary
- Word definitions
- Etymology
- Pronunciation
- International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA)
- Language reference
- MediaWiki
- Creative Commons licensing
- Collaborative content
- Community portal
- CJK (Chinese, Japanese, Korean)
- Proto-Indo-European
- Wikidata integration
- Open-source
- Wiki administration

## Getting Started

- [Wiktionary Main Page](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wiktionary:Main_Page): Main homepage and entry point for Wiktionary free multilingual dictionary
- [Help Contents](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Help:Contents): Help index and documentation for editing and using Wiktionary
- [Glossary of Terms](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Appendix:Glossary): Glossary of linguistic and grammatical terminology used in Wiktionary
- [Contact Us](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wiktionary:Contact_us): Contact methods and support channels for Wiktionary inquiries

## Community & Collaboration

- [Community Portal](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wiktionary:Community_portal): Community portal with forums, discussion areas, and collaboration tools
- [Recent Changes](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Special:RecentChanges): Track recent edits and monitor community contributions to Wiktionary
- [Requested Entries](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wiktionary:Requested_entries): Process for requesting new word entries across multiple languages
- [New Pages](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Special:NewPages): Recently created entries and content moderation tools
- [Main Page Discussion](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wiktionary_talk:Main_Page): Discussion page for main page feedback and feature requests

## Content & References

- [Example Entry: 'free'](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/free): Example dictionary entry with pronunciation, etymology, definitions
- [All Languages](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Category:All_languages): Index of all languages covered in Wiktionary
- [All Topics](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Category:All_topics): Categorical index of topics and semantic organization
- [Random Entry](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Special:Random): Random word entry feature for browsing Wiktionary content

## Statistics & Administration

- [Site Statistics](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Special:Statistics): Site-wide statistics and metrics for Wiktionary content
- [Wiktionary Statistics](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Wiktionary:Statistics): Detailed statistics on entries, languages, and user activity
- [Special Pages](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Special:SpecialPages): Index of special administrative and maintenance pages

## Optional & Reference

- [Pages Linking to Main Page](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Special:WhatLinksHere/Wiktionary:Main_Page): Backlinks and page references to main page
- [Related Changes](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/Special:RecentChangesLinked/Wiktionary:Main_Page): Track changes to pages linked from main page
